attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This removes public API surface used across the display pipeline (ShapeDescriptor.BindingSources, ShapeMetadata.BindingSources, seals FeatureShapeDescriptor/ShapeDescriptorIndex/ShapeBinding, makes Binding/BindingSource non-virtual), which will break any theme/module that overrides these members, relies on BindingSources for localization scoping, or inherits from the now-sealed classes."}

reason: This removes public API surface used across the display pipeline (ShapeDescriptor.BindingSources, ShapeMetadata.BindingSources, seals FeatureShapeDescriptor/ShapeDescriptorIndex/ShapeBinding, makes Binding/BindingSource non-virtual), which will break any theme/module that overrides these members, relies on BindingSources for localization scoping, or inherits from the now-sealed classes.
